text: By the wet first week of March, Varnholt Logistics had already begun its annual reshuffle, but the appointment that drew the most notice was the elevation of Ilse Marrenkamp to chief executive. The board confirmed her on March 4, ending a three-month interim period after the retirement of Rudi Veld. Marrenkamp, 52, had spent 18 years inside the freight group, most recently as operations director, and is credited with steering the company through last winter’s port delays and a 7 percent rise in regional contracts. Founded in 1978 as a family haulage firm, Varnholt has grown into a cross-border operator with 1,200 employees and depots in six towns, yet its leadership remains closely watched in the valley where it started.
